v0.3.1 Attribution Rules

Roster: embedded normalized 2026–2027 Parent Contacts. Sync: D1 batch writes avoid Worker subrequest limits. Matching: email is case-insensitive. Credit: one program gets 100%; two get 50% each; three get 33.3% each. Date filter: dashboard totals use the SignUpGenius assignment start timestamp. Review: only emails absent from the roster remain unmatched.
